payload.gap_claim: Against the scanned field of pairing a push channel: hand-editing the config sheds usability (no gesture, error-prone); a hosted QR API sheds security (it leaks the topic, which is the credential); ntfy subscribe-by-typing sheds the one-gesture property. Ours - one click on the board renders a locally-encoded QR the owner scans - is the only option that keeps all three: gesture + secrecy + one-click install.
payload.why_now: i8 shipped the from-away bless and the phone.json shape; the board has a details pane and a header for a toolbar; i5b/i5c just made a worktree iteration show and bless on the board. So the only missing pieces are the pairing GESTURE and a local QR encoder - a small delta (toolbar + connect action + a vendored/hand-rolled encoder), not new infrastructure.
payload.value_props:
One audience - the owner - one one-pager:
Audience: the owner, wanting to bless from away.
Alternative today: hand-edit a secret config file; the lane stays untested with a device.
Difference: click-then-scan pairing, topic encoded locally.
Validation signal: the owner scans once and blesses a real gate from away.

Needs (need | outcome | pass line):
- Pair without hand-editing | click the phone icon, a QR appears, scan it, phone.json is written enabled | TEST: the connect action writes phone.json with a generated topic + enabled=true and returns a QR for that topic.
- The topic never leaks | the QR is encoded on our side | TEST: the encode path makes no external network call; the topic is sent nowhere.
- Install stays one-click | encoder vendored or hand-rolled | TEST: the encoder turns a known input into the correct QR matrix (known-answer vector); a new dependency passes the ship-review.
- The toolbar shows | a top-middle toolbar: a greyed book icon (until i6) + an active phone-connect icon | board render check (owner redline).
payload.business_case: Skipped with reason: no external acquirer - i8c is internal tooling for the owner's own use. The currency is the owner's own reachability (blessing from away), captured in the value-prop pass lines.
